name: Zachary Buck

tenures.role: co-owner of the promotion and its lead heel manager
tenures.source: the founding pitch document (accession 0001), served at /promotions/bbw/archive/pitch.html
tenures.note: Declared in the pitch's own "IMPORTANT PEOPLE" section. Buck Brothers Wrestling never launched — no card, show, or result of any kind survives or is known to have existed — so the role is a promise the document makes, never a record of anything worked. Graded "billing" for exactly that reason.

caption: One of the two brothers who own the flea market the wrestling was invented to advertise, and the lead heel manager of the promotion that came out of it — utterly horrible at the job, with the question of whether that is deliberate left open.
notes: Also the source of the entrance music: the twenty-song CD burned for the boombox, from which every wrestler's music is drawn at random, is his.
